instruction.text: Find the snow on the train tracks to learn more.

feedback.end: In most of the UK, snow is very unusual. Normally, snow means that our trains have to stop running, and that we should avoid going anywhere in the car. It is very fun for sledging though!

instruction.text: Select the image of a blizzard to learn more.

text: A blizzard happens when it snows and there is a lot of wind. Blizzards are freezing cold and can be very hard to see in.

instruction.text: What should we do when there is snow or a blizzard? Select the correct options.

feedback.finish: Even though this kind of weather is extreme in the UK, in other countries, it’s very common.

instruction.text: Find and select the train to learn more about snow in other countries.

feedback.end: This is a train in Canada. The train here has to be able to run in the snow, because they have snow all winter.

atoms.a: Snow is unusual in most of the UK.
Blizzards happen when it is snowing and very windy.
